placements.why: The envelope's content is instrument calibration work — a Kestrelwood spectrograph tuned and verified against June reference plates. No existing strata category was supplied to hold this; the org's named strata explicitly includes a Calibration tier per the role description, but it has not yet been minted in this repo. This is exactly the kind of organizational category the content calls for, minted fresh with no forced parent.
placements.title: Instrument calibration as a standing organizational category
placements.frame: Does this content report the verified, current calibration state of an instrument against a defined reference standard?

placements.title: Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration holds against reference plates
placements.frame: What is the current, verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and does it continue to hold against the standing reference plates?
placements.why: src-1 narratively reports the spectrograph now calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates, holding across the full observing band. src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument/calibration facts as flat field-label cataloguing rather than new content. This is a subject future calibration envelopes will keep feeding (re-verification, drift checks, new reference plates) — not a one-time fact, so it earns a leaf rather than living only as position support. No existing narrative leaf was supplied to hold instrument-calibration themes, so nothing plausibly reuses; minted fresh under the newly-minted Calibration strata.
